categories.main_business_segments: QuakeSafe Technologies Co., Ltd. specializes in seismic isolation and vibration control technologies for buildings and industrial equipment. Its primary business includes consulting, structural design, R&D, production, sales, installation guidance, monitoring, and maintenance of seismic isolation and damping products. Key product lines include seismic isolation rubber bearings, elastic sliding bearings, energy dissipation dampers, seismic support hangers, nuclear power seismic products, subway cover building vibration control products, and vibration control products for precision instruments and industrial facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced seismic isolation technologies such as laminated rubber bearings, friction pendulum bearings, viscous dampers, metal yield dampers, and tuned mass dampers. Production involves high-temperature, high-pressure vulcanization of rubber and steel laminates, precision mechanical processing, and customized design for specific vibration control needs. It also integrates intelligent monitoring systems for real-time product condition assessment and employs research on high-strength, high-toughness steel for enhanced energy dissipation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include owners and contractors of public buildings such as schools, hospitals, airports, and other municipal projects, accounting for the majority of demand. The company also serves industrial sectors including nuclear power, petrochemical, steel, and high-precision manufacturing. Emerging markets include subway cover properties, industrial plants, and vibration-sensitive equipment manufacturers. The geographic focus is mainly within China, targeting seismic-prone regions and expanding nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yunnan (headquarters), Hebei (Tangshan), and Jiangsu (Changzhou). It has established regional sales centers in Southwest, North China, and East China regions and is expanding its market presence across multiple provinces. There is also a strategic intent to explore overseas markets aligned with China's 'going global' strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: QuakeSafe Technologies operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the seismic isolation industry supply chain. It manufactures core seismic isolation and damping products and provides integrated design, consulting, installation, and maintenance services, positioning itself as a full-solution provider in the seismic isolation ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced seismic isolation materials, intelligent monitoring systems for product health, high-performance vibration isolation devices for high-rise buildings and subway cover structures, and energy dissipation technologies using high-strength steel. It actively participates in national and industry standard setting and focuses on green manufacturing and digital transformation to enhance production efficiency and sustainability. Future R&D also targets expanding applications in industrial and energy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of seismic isolation and damping products, along with consulting, design, installation guidance, and after-sales maintenance services. The company follows a direct sales model targeting owners and contractors, with some projects requiring bidding processes. It also earns income from leasing equipment and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and the only A-share listed company specializing exclusively in seismic isolation and vibration control products in China. It holds a high market share in the national building seismic isolation sector and is recognized as an industry leader with strong technical capabilities and comprehensive solution offerings. Competitors are mainly smaller manufacturers with less integrated service capabilities and weaker R&D strength.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 417 million, a 39.9% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 141 million. Despite revenue decline due to market competition and strategic tightening of sales and credit policies, operating cash flow improved by 23.4%. Total assets stood at RMB 2.47 billion with net assets of RMB 1.64 billion, reflecting a stable asset base but ongoing profitability challenges. The company continues to invest in R&D with expenditures of RMB 32.5 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: QuakeSafe Technologies emphasizes its comprehensive, full-lifecycle seismic isolation solutions combining advanced product quality, strong R&D capabilities, and customized design services. Its products meet or exceed national standards, ensuring high reliability and safety in seismic events. The company leverages its geographic advantage in a high seismic risk region and proximity to raw materials to optimize costs. Its intelligent monitoring systems and participation in standard-setting enhance its competitive edge, positioning it as a trusted partner for critical infrastructure requiring superior seismic protection.
